name: homebase
description: Homebase, your team's asset library: find, fetch, upload, tag and organise brand and campaign assets from your agent.

interface.shortDescription: Your team's asset library: find, fetch and organise brand and campaign files
interface.longDescription: Search your Homebase workspace in plain words ("latest files from the summer campaign"), look at previews, get download links, upload and tag new assets, and organise them into buckets for client handoffs. Uses the Homebase MCP server, or the bundled homebase CLI when only a shell is available. Deletes always show a preview and wait for your yes; nothing is ever sent to clients.
defaultPrompt: Find the latest files from the summer campaign in Homebase
Upload ./exports to Homebase, tagged final, into the Acme bucket
